faqs.a:
Upon a conviction, arbitration award or entry of judgment by a court or disinterested
               third person or determination by city council as provided herein of a violation of
               section 2-55, the city council by a two-thirds vote of the members of city council
               entitled to vote thereon may impose the following penalties:
(1)
If the violation was unintentional or an oversight, the city council shall issue a
                  verbal admonition which shall be part of the record of proceedings.
(2)
If the conduct was negligent, the city council shall issue an official written reprimand
                  which shall be part of the record of proceedings.
(3)
If the conduct was intentional, the city council may censure the officer and may impose
                  a penalty of a fine equivalent to up to one month of the officer's pay which they
                  receive as a board member.
(4)
Each repeat violation for which subsections (a) and (b) of this section apply, shall
                  also be punishable by impositions of a fine not to exceed one month of the officer's
                  pay which they receive as a board member.
(5)
The penalties provided for in this section shall not foreclose the application of
                  any other cause of action, or right of action arising under the city Code, Charter
                  or other applicable state law.
(6)
A conviction, arbitration, or entry of judgment by a court or disinterested third
                  person of a violation of
section 2-375
shall not be grounds for removal pursuant to this Code.
(Code 1981, § 2-61; Ord. No. 3088, § 2, 6-27-1994)
